name: Brood vent icon
description: UI slot icon for the broodling. Composes `ss.proj.drone` via `use`, so the thing in the slot is the thing the player is carrying — when that document stopped being a cold shell plate and became a vent, and again when the vent was redrawn as a body with a pucker in it, this followed with no edit here. Rim is `$venom.dark`, the same as `ss.icon.might`, whose trait it awakens with: the pair reads as a pair on the bar, in the green of the solutions the two are drawn from on the level-up.

evolved.description: Gold-rimmed evolved twin (the old i_drone_evo), derived rather than drawn again.
